summary: Frontend-only verification of new 'LevelBadge' (medal-tier badge) on plan 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)' (Boxeo, 47 sem). Verified badge on EvaluationSection hero '% Promedio' AND on AthleteRanking rows. All 4 threshold levels (Diamante/Oro/Plata/Bronce) mapped correctly. Rookie (<40) not observed directly but code path trivial. No regressions in login, dashboard, evaluation, ranking.

design_issues.screen: Radix DialogContent (Planes sheet, Reporte Maestro modal)
issues: Pre-existing a11y warnings 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' — carried over from iteration 113/114, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: LevelBadge.jsx: clean, small, self-contained. Thresholds 90/75/60/40 match spec. getLevel returns null on non-numeric input (protects against NaN) and LevelBadge returns null in that case (no crash). data-testid='level-badge-<key>' pattern is consistent.

EvaluationSection.js hero conditional 'aspects.some(a => a.value !== \'\' && a.value != null)' correctly hides the badge on empty controls (0% with no measured aspects) — verified with three real 0% history items that render NO badge.

AthleteRanking.js correctly gates badge behind r.has_data (only rows with data show badge). showLabel={false} verified — text label absent, icon + tooltip only. Uses r.evaluation_avg ?? r.score which is spec-compliant.

Pre-existing hydration warning about <span> inside <option> in EvaluationSection athlete-select (react-devtools/x-ve overlay artifact) — not related to LevelBadge, but should be looked at eventually as it triggers 'cannot be a child of' React warning.
Pre-existing 404 on one resource (unchanged from iteration 114). No functional impact.
seed_data_creation: Modified 'Valor Medido' of aspect 'FC en reposo' (id f7a0c722e2) inside the 74% history control of Control Médico for plan 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)'. Final value = 85 (last commit reached 88% Oro). Also changed 'Presión arterial sistólica' Valor to 167 (100%). This shifted that historical control to 88% (from 74%). Non-destructive — original was easily re-editable, but tester did NOT restore the original value 69. If subsequent tests need the original 74% control, main agent may want to restore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reach the badges: login super admin → 'Planes' button top-nav → select 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)' → 'Datos' top-nav → 'Evaluación' section-tab (data-testid=section-tab-evaluacion). The hero '% Promedio' card renders the LevelBadge inside a wrapper data-testid='eval-level-badge' → inner span data-testid='level-badge-<key>' with key in {diamond, gold, silver, bronze, rookie}. Threshold map: >=90 diamond, 75-89 gold, 60-74 silver, 40-59 bronze, <40 rookie. To trigger badge you need at least one aspect with a measured value. To change % Promedio use 'Formulario' subtab (eval-medical-view-form) and edit the input with testid eval-medical-aspect-value-<aspectId>; the Valor Medido is mapped linearly across scale_min/scale_max of the aspect. For AthleteRanking: default Panel de Control (activePanel!='datos') → scroll to Ranking del Equipo (data-testid=athlete-ranking-card). Rows: data-testid=ranking-row-<athleteId>. Rows with r.has_data render a compact icon-only LevelBadge (showLabel=false) next to the R/E stats. Rows without data (opacity-50) render NO badge.

Hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (EvaluationSection line 647 athlete-select) — pre-existing artifact from visual editor overlay, non-blocking.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as designed. Threshold mapping in LevelBadge.js matches spec exactly (>=90/75/60/40 → diamond/gold/silver/bronze; else rookie). Conditional rendering in EvaluationSection ensures badge is hidden until at least one aspect has a numeric value. AthleteRanking correctly gates badge on r.has_data and passes showLabel={false} for icon-only compact display.
